description: This PHP source file defines the class 'CleanCSV' within the 'SuiteCRM' namespace. The class provides mechanisms to escape CSV cell fields by prepending an escape character if the cell starts with certain characters that could be interpreted specially in CSV or spreadsheet applications. It includes properties for escape character and starting characters, along with methods to retrieve these properties and to escape individual CSV fields.

classes.name: CleanCSV
classes.description: Provides methods to escape CSV fields starting with specific characters by prepending an escape character.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CleanCSV instance with a specified escape character and starting characters to be escaped.

methods.name: getStartingChars
methods.description: Returns the array of characters that should trigger the escape in CSV fields.

methods.name: getEscapeChar
methods.description: Returns the escape character used for escaping CSV fields.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Escapes a CSV cell by prepending the escape character if the cell begins with one of the starting characters.
